description: The chart illustrates the distribution of "Matched" and "Not Matched" categories across various hallucination-related labels, with the primary purpose of comparing the proportions of these categories. The horizontal axis represents the percentage values, ranging from 0% to 100% in increments of 20%, while the vertical axis lists the categories, namely "No Hallucination", "Oriented", "Active", "Self-aware", "Rigorous", and "Correct". Each category is represented by a stacked bar, comprising two segments: "Matched" in blue and "Not Matched" in light blue, as indicated by the legend. The "Matched" segment dominates in all categories, with values ranging from 94% for "Self-aware" to 99% for "Correct", while the "Not Matched" segment ranges from 1% for "Correct" and "No Hallucination" to 6% for "Self-aware". The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart effectively displays the relative proportions of "Matched" and "Not Matched" categories for each hallucination-related label.
